title: Update forgiven-state message text to exact user-provided sentence

requirements.summary: Replace the forgiven-state sentence in the post-"Yes" thank-you screen with the exact user-provided text rendered verbatim.
acceptanceCriteria: After clicking "Yes", the forgiven-state message contains the exact text: "sorry mujhe maaf kardo, mere bolne se aapko shak lagta hai but mai nahi karta hun shak aapse , sorry kiki aaj se try karunga sahi se baat karna I'm really sorry aapko asa feel karane keliye".
The previous sentence "I never doubted you, not even for a moment. 💕" is no longer shown anywhere in the forgiven-state message.
The inserted text is not translated or altered by any localization/formatting logic (it renders verbatim in the UI).

file_operations.description: In the forgiven-state (the screen rendered when `forgiven` is true after clicking "Yes"), replace the existing sentence "I never doubted you, not even for a moment. 💕" with the exact provided sentence, preserving punctuation/casing/spacing exactly and ensuring it is rendered as a plain string with no localization/transformation.
